p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, start-up, investment platform: the official authorities of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the updated official sources, then read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for commodity and country, customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Card (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labels and health regulations that this country imposes on products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade to and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: customs codes and duties on imports to the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international business, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform has not been marked by a regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A website opens in its own language: use the translation of your browser, or "Leave a document" for a document.When making an important decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: Guidelines for buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs reports: an authorized customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market access card (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: Taric: customs codes (HS codes) and duties on imports into the EU
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transportation document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Fare (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting goods within the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificates, permits, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods finished for export to the buyer’s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: seller loads on ship; after that the risk and cost is buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: seller pays freight and insurance to port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers at destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: seller pays all, import duties included.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or regulated everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some drugs. Such listing is refused and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the detailed regulations for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and receives nothing from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Shipping Prices worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash pickup in very many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash pickup, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market rate, fees shown before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash pickup
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to your mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount you get: fees + exchange rate, any rate that is worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often, identity documents are required, both for sending and for downloading.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only meet online, or to "open" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Service and price changes: Always check on their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, work out the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping is selling products that the supplier sends directly to the customer. Easy to start, but you are responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeit, no regular products without license.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesaler/supplier" listing here or wholesale platform) and order samples before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Find out the real price: product, shipping costs, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and refunds.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting customer rights: clear prices with taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: Supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from a non-EU country pays VAT from the first euro.
